s:service.name: ApiKeyService
s:service.s:description: Service for managing API keys that allow programmatic access to a place.

s:method.name: Create
s:method.description: Creates a new API key for the specified place. The raw key is returned only once.

s:parameter.name: placeId
s:parameter.description: The place to create the API key for

s:parameter.name: label
s:parameter.description: A human-readable label for this API key

s:parameter.name: permissions
s:parameter.description: The set of Shiro wildcard permissions to grant to this key

s:return.name: id
s:return.description: The UUID of the created API key

s:return.name: key
s:return.description: The raw API key. This is the only time it will be returned.

s:method.name: ListKeys
s:method.description: Lists all API keys for the specified place. Secrets are never returned.

s:parameter.name: placeId
s:parameter.description: The place to list API keys for

s:return.name: keys
s:return.description: List of API key metadata (id, label, keyPrefix, permissions, created, lastUsed)

s:method.name: Revoke
s:method.description: Revokes an API key, permanently disabling it.

s:parameter.name: placeId
s:parameter.description: The place the API key belongs to

s:parameter.name: id
s:parameter.description: The UUID of the API key to revoke
